entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Eiko's boyfriend, Tsukasa, has been[n]sending me a lot of texts recently.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: His days and nights are reversed[n]due to his work, so he often sends[n]me a "good morning" late at night...
Do you think he likes you?
Does Eiko know about this?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not sure. I'd definitely tell Eiko if he[n]asked me on a date...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But for now things are generally pretty[n]normal. Mostly messages like "how's ur[n]bf" and "hope u had a gr8 day 2day."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Do you think their relationship[n]could actually be serious?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Was I just biased to think that all he[n]wants from Eiko is her money?
Probably a little.
You watch too many soap operas.
He's definitely suspicious.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I mean, it does sound like a TV show.[n]A lying host that tricks women into debt,[n]then forces them to sell their bodies...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... those kinds of things exist[n]in reality as well. Immoral hosts,[n]human trafficking rings...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My father even mentioned to me about[n]gangs of men that look specifically[n]for depressed women in Shinjuku...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: They take advantage of the loneliness[n]those girls feel to force them into[n]horribly abusive situations...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Then after ensuring the girls are[n]buried in crippling debt, they make[n]them sell their bodies to pay it off.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There are other ways they force[n]girls into it as well. Blackmail,[n]illegal immigration...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There are countless victims of[n]schemes like that...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Countless gangs as well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My father was going after a[n]particularly notorious one when...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In the course of his investigation,[n]he was hit by an errant truck...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...The impact killed him instantly.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: At first it was thought to be an accident...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But at the funeral, I overheard[n]my father's supervisor speaking[n]with my sister.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He was saying my father had likely been[n]assassinated.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: They suspected that the gang he was[n]investigating hired the driver...
Who was their leader?
What gang was it?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I don't know. The driver died on impact[n]as well... but apparently, they found[n]drugs in his bloodstream.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Either way, that gang has been pushed[n]back into the shadows thanks to the[n]Shinjuku cleanup operation...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not sure any of that would[n]have happened if not for the[n]incident with my father...
That's a horrible story.
Was it tough without him?
He was a noble man.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It is... And we still haven't been able[n]to help the victims of those horrible[n]crimes...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It was... I wanted to continue[n]his work, but there was nothing[n]I could do by myself...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He truly was, wasn't he?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I wish I could be a little[n]more like him myself...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Instead, I've just been hesitant.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's actually why my sister became[n]a prosecutor to begin with.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She couldn't stand by and watch[n]as evil prevailed over justice...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That passion undoubtedly came from[n]our father.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Our mother passed away many years[n]back, so when father was killed,[n]we had to survive on our own.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The responsibility... The pressure[n]of that all fell on my sister.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Because of that, she can't help but talk[n]down on our father at times... She says[n]death is no different than surrender...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... I still look up to him.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was often lonely because of how[n]much time he spent at work...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But seeing him tirelessly pursue[n]one case after the next was[n]nothing short of incredible.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That was how my father chose to live[n]his life... Trying to bring justice and[n]order to the world around him.
That's admirable.[clr 27]
I'm sure he was happy.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Come to think of it, there was something[n]he used to say to me all the time...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: "The most important part of your[n]life is how you choose to live it."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How have I chosen to live...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And more importantly, how do I[n]want to live...?
Do you have an answer?[clr 27]
You can figure that out now.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Just one.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That is, I've never put any[n]thought into the matter before.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now...? You're right. I can still[n]change my path going forward...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To be honest, I've been determined to[n]follow the path my sister laid for me...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: After my father's death, I wanted[n]to lighten the burden on her as[n]much as I possibly could...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: O-Oh, we were supposed to be[n]talking about Eiko here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sorry for going so off topic...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know, I've never actually talked to[n]anyone about my father.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's such a painful memory to[n]look back on...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But I feel comfortable discussing it[n]with you. And beyond that, I think I[n]understand my life a bit better now...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So... thank you.
I can sense a deep bond[n]of trust from Makoto...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, it's Eiko... gloating again.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: "Mayb I'll like, skip college n just[n]get married 2 Tsukasa insted."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I guess she's choosing how she[n]wants to live too. As long as[n]she's sure she'll be happy...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, another message. Huh...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: "U serious abt [lName]-kun?"[n]"Wanna hav a double wedding?"
I'm game if you are.[clr 27]
What are you going to say?
Refuse her, please.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *giggle* Don't be ridiculous.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I couldn't even begin to think about[n]marriage at this point in my life.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm... I'll respond, "I dunno."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I couldn't even begin to think about[n]marriage at this point in my life.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Right. We need to make sure she doesn't[n]go and reserve a wedding hall for us.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I couldn't even begin to think about[n]marriage at this point in my life.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...By the way, can you keep pretending[n]to be my boyfriend for a bit longer?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's the best method I have of[n]keeping tabs on Eiko and Tsukasa.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: At any rate, thanks for listening[n]to me today. I'll let you know if[n]anything urgent comes up.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: See you later.
